title: RMB Ultra-trail Cape Town 2025 — UTCT 100 MILE ITRA results
claims: The 2025 UTCT 100 MILE men's top three were Douglas Pickard 21:49:11, Admire Muzopambwa 22:41:40 and Mark Winter 23:49:52.
The 2025 UTCT 100 MILE women's top three were Nicolette Griffioen 24:40:58, Simone Malan 26:39:35 and Kerry Ann Marshall 27:26:30.
Griffioen's 24:40:58 was fifth overall in the 2025 100-mile results.

verification.note: ITRA 2025 UTCT 100 MILE results page (102583) read directly on 2026-11-20. The table gives overall positions and gender; the top three women are Griffioen, Malan and Marshall.

claimVerification.note: Table: Griffioen 24:40:58 F; Malan 26:39:35 F; Marshall 27:26:30 F.
Griffioen appears after four men in the overall table, so she is fifth overall and first woman.
